title: Asynchronous Cloud VM Bug Fixing and Dependency Upgrades
oneLiner: Google Jules clones GitHub repositories into isolated cloud virtual machines, runs setup scripts, fixes bugs or upgrades dependencies asynchronously, and submits ready-to-review pull requests.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
